name: Digital China Holdings Limited
summary: Digital China Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides big data products and solutions for government and enterprise customers in Mainland China. It operates through three segments: Data Intelligence Services Business, Integrated Supply Chain Services Business, and Fintech Services and Others Business. The Data Intelligence Services Business segment provides data intelligence decision-making platforms and full-stack AI technical services centered on computing power, data, algorithm models and intelligent applications; and offers power planning and construction, coordinated scheduling, optimization and reengineering, and computing power asset management.
